# BalloonCraft KC

BalloonCraft KC is a Kansas City metro balloon decor studio offering custom balloon installations for weddings, birthdays, baby showers, graduations, corporate events, grand openings, galas, and private celebrations.

## Primary services

- Balloon arches
- Balloon garlands
- Balloon walls
- Balloon columns
- Balloon backdrops
- Balloon sculptures
- Marquee-letter balloon styling
- Delivery, setup, and on-site installation

## Service area

- Kansas City, Missouri
- Overland Park, Kansas
- Olathe, Kansas
- Lee's Summit, Missouri
- Shawnee, Kansas
- Lenexa, Kansas
- Leawood, Kansas
- Prairie Village, Kansas
- Independence, Missouri
